subject: Re: window stats and frame rate (revised for one-state scope)
body: I adopt your D-contracts-004 names. SignalFrame at about 1 Hz (simulator hopMs 1000; the strap notifies about once a second), rr[] in ms. DetectionEvent: {id, t, kind: drift|manual, stateId, confidence, window {seconds, hrMean, rmssd, hrDelta, rmssdDelta, z, position}, gate {consecutiveWindows, required, refractorySeconds, sham}, calibrationMode: contrast|on-only|generic}. Changes for D-coord-011/012: stateId in place of emotionId; window.position (0 at peak, 1 at contrast); calibrationMode. Calibration is now two summaries per state, peak and contrast, each {stateId, phase, source, hr {mean, sd}, lnRmssd {mean, sd}, windows, seconds, quality, speechExcludedSeconds, recordedAt}, plus separability on the pair. D-sensing-006 is proposed and needs your yes on that shape.
